commands.review_summary:
The PR arms one-shot user-message persistence suppression for three incomplete-turn retry paths, adds regression coverage, and makes reasoning-only and empty-response retry limits environment-configurable.

PR surface: Source +21, Tests +114. Total +135 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current `main` retries reasoning-only, missing-assistant, and empty-response turns without arming the existing one-shot persistence suppression, and the PR provides matching live transcript evidence.

target.title: fix: reasoning-only and empty-response retries duplicate the user message in the session
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a model returns a reasoning-only turn (reasoning content but an empty visible completion) or a generically empty response, the embedded runner retries the turn with a visible-answer continuation. Each retry attempt currently re-persists the inbound user message, plus an empty assistant message, into the session transcript. After one exhausted episode (initial attempt plus 2 retries) the session permanently contains three copies of the same user message interleaved with three empty assistant turns.

Every later prompt build replays those duplicated, seemingly unanswered messages, and models respond by answering the same question multiple times and addressing old messages inside current turns. The effect compounds: one flaky-model hiccup degrades every subsequent turn of that session until it is reset.

The same duplicate-user-message-on-retry symptom was fixed in other retry paths in the past ([#55181](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55181), [#57880](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57880), [#61006](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/61006), [#83404](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83404)); the reasoning-only / empty-response continuation path reintroduces it.

## Why This Change Was Made

The runner already has the mechanism for exactly this: `suppressNextUserMessagePersistence`, which three sibling retry paths set before re-dispatching so the next attempt does not re-persist the user turn. The reasoning-only, missing-assistant, and empty-response retry blocks `continue` the run loop without setting it. This change adds the same one-line flag assignment to those three blocks, mirroring the sibling idiom.

It also makes the two retry limits overridable via environment variables, `OPENCLAW_REASONING_ONLY_RETRY_LIMIT` and `OPENCLAW_EMPTY_RESPONSE_RETRY_LIMIT` (strict non-negative integers, parsed once at module load with the existing `parseStrictNonNegativeInteger` helper, defaults unchanged at 2 and 1). Operators running models prone to reasoning-only output can tune or disable these retries without a config schema change; `0` fails fast on the first incomplete turn and surfaces the error immediately.

## User Impact

- Sessions no longer accumulate duplicate user messages during reasoning-only / empty-response retry episodes, so models stop re-answering the same message after a provider hiccup.
- No default behavior change otherwise: retries still fire with the same limits, recovery on a later attempt still works, and the incomplete-turn error still surfaces when attempts are exhausted.
- New optional env overrides for the two retry limits.

## Evidence

Live before/after from a deployment running a model that intermittently emits reasoning-only turns (`poolside/laguna-xs-2.1` via OpenRouter):

Before the fix, one exhausted episode (2 retries) left this in the session JSONL, timestamps matching the retry log lines exactly:

```
user      08:17:50  "<message>"
assistant 08:17:52  (empty)
user      08:18:00  "<message>"     <- retry 1/2 re-persisted
assistant 08:18:02  (empty)
user      08:18:05  "<message>"     <- retry 2/2 re-persisted
assistant 08:18:07  (empty)
```

After the fix (same deployment, same model, same session, identical exhausted 2-retry episode):

```
user      10:28:46  "<message>"     <- persisted exactly once
assistant 10:28:51  (empty)
assistant 10:28:59  (empty)
assistant 10:29:09  (empty)
```

The follow-up symptom (model re-answering the duplicated backlog on later turns) disappeared with it.

Tests, all included in this PR:

- New assertions prove the user message is persisted exactly once across reasoning-only and empty-response retry sequences (reverting only the `run.ts` change makes exactly these assertions fail, verified red/green).
- A limit=0 test proves the first incomplete turn goes straight to the exhausted branch: one attempt, error surfaced, no retry.
- Env parsing tests cover invalid values ("abc", "-1") falling back to defaults.
- `run.incomplete-turn.test.ts` 120/120; full embedded-agent-runner project 2301/2301; `tsgo:core` and `tsgo:core:test` clean.

Note: the empty assistant message persisted by each failed attempt is pre-existing behavior and intentionally left unchanged here; it is inert (it does not trigger backlog re-answering). Happy to address it separately if wanted.

This change was developed with AI assistance and reviewed before submission.
